levels.label: Local pilot
levels.allowed_claim: The W1 pilot normalizes a supported Quality Runner report into a named, source-located finding.
levels.forbidden_inference: The pilot is a fully verified IDE extension or hosted product.

levels.label: Freshness boundary
levels.allowed_claim: The model surfaces that the fixture report target is stale relative to the inspected checkout.
levels.forbidden_inference: A stale report is a current passing quality result.

levels.label: Human ownership
levels.allowed_claim: A human disposition is carried into a rerun model for the same finding.
levels.forbidden_inference: Acceptance means the underlying source was fixed or the finding was objectively false.

levels.label: Binary preview
levels.allowed_claim: The candidate packet includes a crop-safe 1600 × 900 PNG preview whose finding, stale state, disposition, and rerun line remain legible.
levels.forbidden_inference: A polished preview proves direct IDE behavior or a hosted case page.

levels.label: Direct IDE acceptance
levels.allowed_claim: The repository contains a VS Code projection that still needs direct Problems-panel readback.
levels.forbidden_inference: The direct Problems-panel and command-palette flow has been accepted end to end.

levels.label: External release
levels.allowed_claim: Deployment and external publication remain unverified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The case is live on GitHub, portfolio, or Handshake.
